items.title: Charles "Creole Charlie" Levy Interview, 1962-01-03
items.q: I had some kids that Professor Dyett sent me. He knew that I would teach them very good fundamentals.

ctx.x: Would you give up fiddle in this period that you've mentioned? Yes.

I had some kids from school. I lived around the corner from DuSable High School. And I had some kids that Professor Dyett sent me. He knew that I would teach them very good fundamentals. And I had some violin students. I had some bander students too. In fact, I taught Jimmy Noon's nephew. Henry. Henry Ford. No, Henry Ford was a bass player. Jimmy Noon's nephew, his last name was Henry. He was from New Orleans too. And Jimmy Noon sent me because he knew that I would teach him right, you know, and take patience…
Well, I remember, it was Jimmy introducing somebody, his nephew, and I thought maybe Henry Ford was in the same group. Yeah, Henry Ford's a bass player. Yeah. I guess not.
